scope: External actual QKV host import, real publication and downstream B1/S64 Decision stage4/layer0 Attention. Not upstream Q8, Encoder/RoPE, numerical RTL or full-top acceptance.
source_inspection: The wrapper includes the exact production Controller once; build links the other 24 official TUs with C++17 -O2 -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off.

BEGIN uses real full_parse_request, Controller::fresh and full_claim_qkv_pair. It observes two FILL owners, no valid/final refs and zero coverage. No production READY/coverage/state injection is used.

Host producer performs production qkv_address/full_write of each 256-byte row and sets receipt bits only after the write returns success. Independent inverse layout checks each byte of both 12 MiB host banks and independent prefix/full-host SHA256.

RUN retains static runtime/pending refs/ticket, does not reparse/reset, validates metadata against BEGIN, calls real coverage spans and full_publish_qkv_pair, then real LOAD_KV/QK/inplace SCORE-PROB/Softmax/AV with fresh refs and TaskDone checks.
Error paths invoke production Controller::invalidate_incomplete. Successful partial output is reported before separately recorded cleanup; this diagnostic does not claim full ATT_OUT publication.

Independent Python full_reference recomputes S64 QK/probability/AV from frozen input; no DUT result is used as gold. Mask, finite arithmetic, fixed QK tree, key-ascending AV and separate FP operations agree with the design.
Generated design change is implementation mapping only; original approved preimage and exact diff are bound. Production fe067 is unchanged.
required_tb_followups_closed: Every accepted BEGIN scans the entire two 12 MiB QKV banks for 0xa5.
Every actual RUN including positive, failed coverage, stale metadata and replay rechecks all QKV bytes and hashes; replay compares the full accepted ATT_OUT image.

Missing plane/nonselected-shard row checks exact production E_BUFFER detail(4,QKV,9), zero tasks/final refs and INVALID owners; partial ATT_OUT publish checks detail(4,ATT_OUT,9). Negative outputs are fully scanned.
Every successful BEGIN enforces ticket and both epochs equal the prior successful value plus one across failures/recovery.
SHA256 abc known-answer and independent fixed digest/build-tag little-endian words are checked; first BEGIN/RUN descriptors match independently generated exact 640-byte pages.
